summary: DPRD fails 4 hard gates. Requirements use aspirational language instead of SHALL statements, non-goals are absent, upstream EL traceability is missing, and one requirement expands scope beyond the frozen upstream artifacts.

blocking_issues.description: §4 Non-Goals is empty. The spec requires at least one explicit non-goal. An empty non-goals section means the scope is unbounded — anything not explicitly required could be considered in scope.

Functional requirements use language like 'the system should classify notifications' and 'the system could provide role-based rules.' Requirements must use 'The system SHALL ...' language. Aspirational or conditional language (should, could, may) does not constitute a requirement.

§7 Upstream Artifact References lists PFD-TASKFLOW-NOTIF-001, VH-TASKFLOW-NOTIF-001, and AR-TASKFLOW-NOTIF-001 but does not reference an Experiment Log. The EL is a mandatory upstream artifact for DPRD generation — its absence or omission from traceability is a hard gate failure.

FR-12 requires 'AI-based notification summarization using natural language generation.' No upstream PFD, VH, AR, or EL artifact defines, tests, or supports NLG summarization as a requirement. This requirement introduces new scope not present in any upstream artifact.
